title: Hollywood Chills 3-Hour Tour: Celebrity Scandals and Cemeteries
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join Tour du Jour as we pay tribute to the twin obsessions of celebrity and death.

On your private 3-hour tour, you’ll visit the final resting places of some of Hollywood’s most beloved stars from long-departed legends to larger-than-life icons like Marilyn Monroe, Natalie Wood, Dean Martin, Farrah Fawcett, to name just a few.

And we’ll take you to the real-life locations where infamous events took place such as Michael Jackson’s last residence and Whitney Houston’s final bath.

From scandalous behavior to murder and suicide –rock stars, movie stars, and child stars.

From the ODs to the DOAs. We know the stories and we know where to look.

Complimentary bottled water and a multi-media iPad presentation of the gone-but-not-forgotten stars and their untimely deaths help round out this popular excursion provided by a highly-rated professional guide.
